messages:
zoe: spontaneous arcade swap tomorrow lunchtime? bring whatever handhelds/switch/steam deck.
pete: ill bring a steam deck + a couple of local multiplayer games. anyone want to try TowerFall?
maya: TowerFall yes. also i can bring HDMI capture if folks want clips.
liam: heads up: mezz outlets are limited. can someone bring a power brick station?
felix: i can bring a 6-socket strip. labeled.
zoe: pete, maya — want to do a short best-of-3 Tourney at 12:30? small prize: a mystery snack box from felix.
maya: i'm in. low-pressure finals! :sparkles:
bot-snacks: snack reminder scheduled for 11:50 AM: "Bring reusable plates + napkins".
liam: FYI, if you're on the corporate wifi and using Steam remote play, set streaming to "fast" to reduce latency.
pete: quick Steam tip: enable low-latency mode in settings under Remote Play.
felix: also, volunteers to tidy afterwards? i can stay until 1:30.
zoe: i'll coordinate pickup and post a short sign-up. see you tomorrow lunch.
